Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 44 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 23 July 2025(Wednesday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca) and Batangas(Calatagan, Balayan, Calaca, Lemery, Taal, San Luis, Bauan, Mabini, Tingloy, San Pascual, Alitagtag, Santa Teresita, San Nicolas, Agoncillo, Lian, Cuenca, San Jose, Ibaan, Batangas City, Taysan, Rosario, Lobo, San Juan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Cavite, Metro Manila, Rizal, Laguna, Quezon, Pampanga(Lubao, Sasmuan, Apalit, Arayat, Bacolor, Candaba, San Fernando, Macabebe, Magalang, Masantol, Mexico, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat, Guagua, Santa Rita), Tarlac(Concepcion, Bamban, Capas, Mayantoc, San Clemente, San Jose, Santa Ignacia, Tarlac City) and Batangas(Balete, Tanauan, Laurel, Lipa, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, Padre Garcia, Santo Tomas, Talisay, Tuy).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Bulacan and Tarlac(Camiling, Paniqui, Gerona, Moncada, San Manuel, Anao, Ramos, Pura, Victoria, La Paz) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
